summary: Innoviz Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q2 2026 earnings press release. The release reports record quarterly revenue of $18.1 million, reiterates FY2026 guidance of $67–73 million, and highlights business updates including the launch of the Perciz defense brand, first defense orders of approximately $3.5 million, and a board appointment. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings and operational update, not a special situation.
